'''Grappler Cranes''' were arm-like mechanical appendages that were installed in the [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|Carbon-freezing chamber]] sub-levels of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Grappler Cranes would lower from the ceiling, and then grab onto objects to lift them. Grappler Cranes could also be installed on the sides of walls, for vertical movement.<ref name="SEMP" />
